title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems

Join Launch Potato to own the recommendation engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

Must Have
  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
Your Role

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

Outcomes
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
Competencies
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

description:
Join to apply for the Senior Research Analyst role at Wood Mackenzie

Wood Mackenzie is the global data and analytics business for the renewables, energy, and natural resources industries. In an ever‑changing world, companies and governments need reliable and actionable insight to lead the transition to a sustainable future. Our team of over 2,400 experts, operating across 30 global locations, enables customers’ decisions through real‑time analytics, consultancy, events and thought leadership.

Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Department

Research

Reports to

Senior Research Manager

About The Role

Wood Mackenzie is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Senior Research Analyst to join our Upstream team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to our industry‑leading research and insights into the global upstream oil and gas sector, helping clients navigate the evolving energy landscape.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver high‑quality research and analysis on upstream assets, companies, and market trends.
  • Maintain and enhance asset‑level valuations and emissions profiles using proprietary models.
  • Interpret complex datasets to identify strategic opportunities and risks.
  • Engage with industry stakeholders to validate assumptions and gather market intelligence.
  • Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistency and accuracy in research outputs.
  • Produce thought leadership content including reports, presentations, and client briefings.
  • Support clients in strategic decision‑making, portfolio benchmarking, and investment analysis.
Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Geoscience, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in upstream oil and gas research, consulting, or industry roles.
  • Strong understanding of upstream operations, asset economics, and fiscal regimes.
  • Experience with valuation models and emissions analysis is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with senior stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Python).
What We Offer
  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment with global exposure.
  • Opportunities to shape industry thinking and influence strategic decisions.
  • Continuous learning and development through mentoring, training, and cross‑functional projects.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your experience and impact.

Descrição da vaga:

Home - CEPEL

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional proativo(a) e comprometido(a) com resultados, que tenha agilidade nas entregas, flexibilidade, resiliência e foco em prazos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Testes unitários e sistêmicos de módulos de software componentes da plataforma, sejam novos artefatos ou que tenham sofrido manutenção corretiva ou evolutiva, geração de módulos corretivos (patches) e atualizações (updates) de todos os componentes de software do sistema e a elaboração e manutenção de documentação correspondente.

  • Capacidade de codificação de funcionalidades nas linguagens de programação C, C++ e Python.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas SCADA para aplicação local e em centros de controle.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de sistema operacional Linux, bases de dados, rede de computadores e seus componentes.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, NoSQL) para coleta e análise de dados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com arquiteturas de sistemas distribuídos e processamento em tempo real.
Conhecimentos Desejáveis
  • Experiência com sistemas de Supervisão e Controle de sistemas elétricos, preferencialmente com a plataforma SAGE, inclusive em suas configurações EMS e PDC, sua instalação, configuração e operação.

  • IEEE1815(DNP3) IEC62541 (OPC UA), IEEE37118 e Modbus.
  • Conhecimento das linguagens de programação Java, Javascript, HTML e CSS.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar e lidar com problemas complexos.

Sobre a Empresa

O Centro de Pesquisas de Energia Elétrica (Cepel), fundado pela Eletrobras em 1974, é a maior instituição de P&D do setor elétrico na América Latina. Com mais de cinco décadas de atuação, é referência como Instituição Científica, Tecnológica e de Inovação (ICT), sem fins lucrativos, combinando um corpo técnico de excelência a uma infraestrutura laboratorial de classe mundial. Presente em todo o Brasil e em nove países, o Cepel desenvolve tecnologias e serviços para geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, promovendo avanços que tornam o setor mais eficiente e confiável. Suas soluções estratégicas abrangem projetos de P&D, consultoria técnica, serviços laboratoriais e tecnologias para planejamento, operação e gestão de sistemas elétricos, além de impulsionar redes mais resilientes e fortalecer a matriz energética nacional.

Missão
  • Desenvolver soluções tecnológicas em energia para a sociedade.
Visão
  • Ser referência internacional em soluções inovadoras em energia.
Valores
  • A vida em primeiro lugar.
  • A nossa energia vem das pessoas.
  • Integridade sempre.
  • Nossa excelência faz a diferença.
  • Inovar para gerar valor.

Driven by our expertise and commitment to innovation, we aim to provide our clients with advanced tools that enable informed decision-making and push the boundaries of subsurface interpretation. title: General Manager
description:
Company Description

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands‑on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship‑building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long‑term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision‑making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world‑class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:
  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

    Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model.

    Build quality relationships with the management team.

    Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak‑up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect.

    Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input.

    Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision‑making processes.

    Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well‑being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards.

    Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations.

    Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty.

    Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets.

    Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel.

    Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market.

    Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan.

    Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning.

    Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities.

    Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement.

    Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures.

    As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy.

    Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members.

    Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process.

    Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem‑solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best.

    Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements.

    Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks.

    Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition.

    Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents.

    Champions a "speak‑up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated.

    Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win‑win solutions.

Additional Information
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)
  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high‑performing cultures.

  • Bottom‑line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team‑building.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Vem ser RJZ Cyrela e transforme o futuro com a gente!

Na Cyrela, transformamos espaços e criamos experiências únicas que encantam e inspiram. Com mais de 60 anos de história, estamos sempre em busca de inovação e sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções diferenciadas no setor imobiliário. Valorizamos o potencial das pessoas e acreditamos que, juntos, podemos construir um futuro melhor. Se você é apaixonado por transformar, colaborar e fazer a diferença, venha fazer parte do impossível, que para nós não é só um ponto de vista, e sim um ponto de partida.

Main responsibilities

O que espera por você no seu dia a dia:

  • Quantificar equipe para execução de serviços de elétrica/hidráulica;
  • Quantificar e requisitar materiais de elétrica/hidrossanitários/gás/incêndio;
  • Conferir qualidade dos serviços executados no canteiro de obra;
  • Acompanhar processo de etapas de compra, até entrega do material no canteiro de obra;
  • Equalizar propostas técnicas/comerciais para quadros de concorrências de elétrica/hidráulica/gás/incêndio;
  • Acompanhar execução dos serviços, conforme cronograma da obra;
  • Realizar treinamentos/reuniões de equipe, para garantia de qualidade de execução dos serviços de elétrica/hidráulica;
  • Acompanhar evolução de custo de material e mão-de-obra, para gerenciamento do orçamento de instalações elétricas/hidrossanitários/gás/incêndio.
Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou Engenharia Civil;
  • Conhecimentos de instalações elétricas, hidráulicas, gás e combate a incêndio;
  • Experiência em execução de obras de instalações elétricas, hidrossanitárias, gás e combate a incêndio;
  • Conhecimento em Autocad;
  • Excel intermediário
Additional information

Local de trabalho: Obras – RJ

Modalidade de trabalho: presencial

Horário de Trabalho: 44h semanais. Sendo segunda-feira à quinta-feira de 07h às 17h e sexta 07h às 16h.

title: MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA - AP 1.0
description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA - AP 1.0 role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atender e acompanhar pacientes portadores de enfermidades inerentes à especialidade, dentro dos padrões exigidos. Prescrever tratamento; Participar de programas voltados para a saúde pública; Realizar observações em clínicas psiquiátricas; Elaborar laudo psiquiátrico correspondentes, com diagnóstico e indicação.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: AP 1.0 (Região Central e Paquetá)

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. - Participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near-misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.

Documentation and Record Keeping:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities.
- Assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures.
- Stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

description:
Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world‑class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need both technical and management skills to lead your team. You will represent the team in direct partner engagement, ensuring stability and functionality that our cloud users expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU‑aided AI for servers, VMs, and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring they grow as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. You will challenge and grow your team members with technical leadership and a solid background in software development. You will influence culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team builds. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Responsibilities
  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

title: Engineer II, Senior
description:
Join to apply for the Engineer II, Senior role at ABS Group .

Job Description

Leads and performs engineering design review and analysis assignments typically involving complex and technically challenging projects. These projects require the application of advanced engineering knowledge and practices. The incumbent will demonstrate a thorough understanding of company policies, procedures, and methods and provide technical guidance to Engineer I and Engineer II positions when necessary.

What You Will Do:
  • With minimal or no supervision performs detailed engineering review of plans, as assigned, for compliance with applicable rules, regulations and contract commitments.
  • Perform and lead detailed mechanical engineering reviews for compliance with Brazilian NRs, international standards, and ABS Group’s policies.
  • Execute advanced Risk‑Based Inspection (RBI) assessments for piping systems, pressure vessels, pressure relief valves, marine, offshore assets, and refinery facilities, including integration of API 579 Fitness‑for‑Service principles.
  • Conduct pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II and assist in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) studies for complex systems.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership in problem‑solving and design conflicts.
  • Develop high‑quality technical reports and communicate project outcomes effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate across multi‑disciplinary teams to identify operational risks and propose optimization plans for mechanical system designs.
  • Stay up‑to‑date with technical developments and evolving regulatory standards to ensure compliance and best practices are maintained.
  • Ensure processes adhere to ABS Group Quality standards and maintain compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental requirements.
What You Will Need: Education and Experience
  • B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering required; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Demonstrated understanding and ability to apply fundamental classification and quality concepts, practices and procedures.
  • Extensive knowledge and application of mechanical engineering, Risk‑Based Inspection (RBI) methodologies, and API 579 Fitness‑for‑Service analysis.
  • Advanced expertise in pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II.
  • Proficiency in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) tools.
  • Track record of managing and leading complex engineering projects within marine, offshore, and refinery environments.
  • Superior problem‑solving and decision‑making skills for a wide range of engineering challenges.
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills necessary for client interaction and technical reporting.
  • Ability to mentor mid‑level engineers and collaborate across functional disciplines.
Reporting Relationships

This position reports to a Senior or Manager level position or above.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Manutenção que ficará responsável pelo gerenciamento de toda equipe de manutenção mecânica, através do acompanhamento de cada etapa dos processos existentes, indicadores de desempenho dos colaboradores, compra dos devidos equipamentos a fim de disponibilizar e garantir uma operação funcional confiável em todos os equipamentos da usina.

#LI-Onsite

Main responsibilities
  • Elaborar e gerenciar os planos de manutenção preditiva e preventiva, que por sua vez, é criado pelo departamento de Engenharia, através das necessidades e estratégias ao avaliar, corrigir e fornecer subsídios, para que o plano possa ser revisado e reciclado constantemente;
  • Assegurar que as atividades de manutenção sejam efetuadas de acordo com os mais rígidos padrões de segurança e criteriosos procedimentos ambientais e de acordo com as estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva, criados pelo Departamento de Engenharia e as solicitações de manutenções corretivas e coordenação diárias, interagindo com os departamentos de Operações, manutenção mecânica, elétrica, instrumentação e civil em conjunto para execução de desenvolvimentos rumando a otimizações de resultados;
  • Assegurar para que os serviços de manutenção contratados nas áreas de civil, mecânica e elétrica sejam executados conforme escopo de serviço e dentro da dotação orçamentária através da supervisão e programação de atividades das empresas contratadas, a fim de obter satisfação do cliente;
  • Orientar, assegurar e desenvolver os profissionais técnicos do departamento acerca de qualifica-los para exercer as atividades de manutenção requeridas, através de identificação de deficiências a fim de criar programação de treinamentos específicos para as devidas reciclagens;
  • Obter melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, contribuindo na redução dos custos da manutenção;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnicas para contratação e feedback de profissionais da área de sua reponsabilidade, para a garantia de inserir a vaga em aberto, bem como criar estratégias para aperfeiçoamento da equipe e obtenção de resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMAS da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMAS e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.
Requirements and skills
  • Superior em engenharia elétrica, eletrônica ou mecânica;
  • Desejável especialização na área técnica ou na área de gestão de qualidade ou administração;
  • Experiência em supervisão de função técnica na área de geração de energia ou industrial ou similar;
  • Conhecimento de Termodinâmica, Vibração, Técnicas Preditivas;

Garantir coerência entre as atividades conduzidas por todas as disciplinas 2G&R envolvidas.

Desenvolvimento da equipe.

Abordagem de melhoria contínua.

Você terá a oportunidade de aplicar seus conhecimentos em desenvolvimento front-end e back-end para criar soluções inovadoras que otimizarão processos e trarão eficiência para a empresa. Se você é apaixonado por projetos e tecnologia, busca desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico, essa vaga é para você!

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders, garantindo a comunicação eficaz e o engajamento de todas as partes envolvidas nos projetos.

Nós somos a V.tal, uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de viabilizar a conexão com o mundo digital transformando a vida das pessoas. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. title: Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala – Supervisor(a) de Contas / Estrategista de UX - 100% home office - Inglês avançado
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala – Supervisor(a) de Contas / Estrategista de UX


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.



Objetivo do Cargo:


O(A) Gerente de CRM e Personalização em Escala atua como o elo estratégico entre a visão de engajamento do consumidor e a execução impecável das campanhas . Como líder funcional no design de jornadas e segmentação de audiência, esse profissional é responsável por transformar insights de consumidores e objetivos de negócio em estratégias avançadas de CRM e Fidelidade , abrangendo múltiplos canais e mercados.

Esse cargo define estruturas de comunicação por ciclo de vida , táticas de personalização e lógicas de segmentação que impulsionam a ativação significativa de dados primários (1P data). Inclui também orientar a priorização de jornadas, garantir consistência entre marcas e plataformas e incorporar ciclos de aprendizado contínuos para otimizar o desempenho.

Embora não execute diretamente nas plataformas, o cargo é o proprietário do modelo funcional (blueprint) — garantindo que as campanhas sejam relevantes para o consumidor, orientadas por dados, tecnicamente viáveis e alinhadas aos objetivos comerciais . Além disso, facilita o alinhamento com as equipes de conteúdo, marketing e implantação , conectando todos os insumos necessários para criar jornadas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto nos resultados de negócio .


Principais Responsabilidades:


1) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

  • Liderar o design e a documentação das jornadas completas de CRM ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do cliente (ex.: aquisição, onboarding, reativação, fidelização), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e viabilidade técnica .
  • Traduzir insights de consumidores e prioridades de marca em lógicas de jornada , definindo gatilhos, tempos de espera, ramificações e metas .
  • Definir e evoluir o roadmap de CRM e Personalização entre marcas e mercados, em linha com as prioridades do setor.
  • Fornecer orientação estratégica às equipes de operação e técnica sobre configuração de jornadas, uso de conteúdo dinâmico e orquestração de mensagens.
  • Ser o responsável funcional pelo (Personalization at Scale) , incorporando sinais comportamentais e contextuais às ativações de CRM.

2) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Colaborar com as equipes de dados para aproveitar modelos preditivos, sinais comportamentais e oportunidades de enriquecimento de dados primários (1PD) .
  • Definir KPIs e métricas de sucesso para programas de CRM, incluindo engajamento, conversão e incremento de receita.
  • Integrar insights de performance em novas iterações estratégicas, identificando oportunidades de teste e aprendizado e lacunas de desempenho .
  • Trabalhar em parceria com líderes de CDP/CDNA para aprimorar a lógica de segmentação e as táticas de personalização orientadas por dados.

3) Alinhamento Multifuncional e Suporte a Stakeholders

  • Atuar como elo estratégico de CRM para as equipes de marca e mercados locais, aconselhando sobre viabilidade e melhores práticas .
  • Guiar a priorização de jornadas e segmentos de consumidores com base em impacto de negócio, nível de personalização e oportunidade de audiência.


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:


  • 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções estratégicas de CRM ou Marketing Direto, com expertise comprovada em marketing de ciclo de vida e personalização em escala .
  • Domínio em personalização orientada por dados , design de jornadas complexas e lógica de segmentação .
  • Conhecimento funcional do Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions e Triggers), suficiente para orientar equipes de execução.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura CDP/CDNA , lógica de ativação e fluxos de integração de audiências.
  • Familiaridade com mecânicas de fidelidade, jornadas de indicação, estratégias de gamificação e modelos de engajamento similares.
  • Perfil analítico , capaz de interpretar resultados de campanhas e traduzir insights em ajustes estratégicos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de sintetizar informações de marca, dados, tecnologia e times globais em estratégias de CRM acionáveis .
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em organizações grandes e matriciais , com ecossistemas de CRM de alto volume.
  • Vivência em CPG (bens de consumo), varejo ou modelos baseados em assinatura .
  • Familiaridade com integrações CRM/adtech (ex.: uso combinado de dados pagos e proprietários para segmentação).
  • Histórico comprovado de melhoria de performance de CRM por meio de comunicações personalizadas e otimização de estratégias.
  • Experiência colaborando no desenvolvimento de templates de jornada , lógicas de decisão e playbooks de personalização .
  • Conhecimento em lógica de UX/CX ou frameworks de comunicação centrados no usuário (não voltados ao design visual).


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.

  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

Inglês avançado

title: Assistente de Departamento Pessoal - Vaga Temporária
description:
Principais atribuições:


Administração de Folha de Pagamento: Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento, realizando lançamentos, conferências e tratamento de inconsistências, assegurando a precisão das informações e o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista, em parceria com o escritório contábil ou fornecedor responsável.

Apuração de Ponto e Banco de Horas: Efetuar o controle, saneamento e fechamento da folha de ponto, garantindo a correta apuração de horas trabalhadas, horas extras, faltas, atrasos e compensações. Realizar a apuração e manutenção do banco de horas, conforme as políticas internas e acordos vigentes.

Cálculos e Rateios: Executar cálculos de férias, rescisões, horas extras, comissões e demais eventos da folha, além de auxiliar na elaboração de rateios e controles mensais.

Gestão de Benefícios: Apoiar a administração dos benefícios concedidos aos colaboradores (vale-transporte, vale-refeição, plano de saúde, entre outros), realizando cadastros, atualizações, inclusões/exclusões e interface com prestadores de serviço.

Controle e Organização de Documentação: Manter a organização e atualização dos arquivos e documentos de pessoal, físicos e digitais, assegurando a integridade, a confidencialidade e a conformidade com as normas internas e legais.


Requisitos:

Conhecimento em rotinas de Departamento Pessoal (admissão, férias, rescisão, folha e ponto);

Domínio de sistemas de ponto eletrônico;

Conhecimento em folha de pagamento e obrigações acessórias (eSocial, DCTFWEB, DIRF,);

Experiência em apuração e controle de banco de horas;

Noções de legislação trabalhista e previdenciária;

Habilidade com Excel (nível intermediário — fórmulas, planilhas de controle, filtros e relatórios);

Desejável vivência com sistemas de folha terceirizados ou parceria com contabilidade externa.
